<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons (HWE) reaction, I will search the template catalog using a representative product (acrylic acid, SMILES C=CC(=O)O). The forward reaction forms an alkene and a carboxylic acid, so I will filter by the functional groups formed: “alkene” and “carboxylic_acid”. No other criteria are needed for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=CC(=O)O",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic_acid"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
